summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the 'Wallet Negocios' -> 'Plataforma de pagos' rename and the new services hub with 6 pillars. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (root health, /api/contacto CRUD + validation + parametrized POST for all 6 new interes values). Frontend: verified /servicios (6 pillars with correct titles + hrefs, 4 more-chips), /servicios/tarjetas (h1, features 0-3, blocks 0-2 with expected titles, servicio-note, servicio-cta -> /contacto), /servicios/nomina-y-dispersion (h1, 3 blocks, servicio-block-link-2 -> /servicios/consultoria-empresarial), /servicios/pagos-internacionales (h1 + partners flexpei/fluxipay opening in new tab with correct URLs), /servicios/plataforma-de-pagos (breadcrumb 'Plataforma de pagos', wallet-section with overline 'Plataforma de pagos' and 6 wallet-feature items including 'Tarjetas empresariales'), /wallet redirects to /servicios/plataforma-de-pagos, Header desktop 'Servicios' dropdown exposes exactly 8 links matching NAV spec, Footer Servicios column contains all 7 service links, no 'Wallet Negocios' text anywhere on Home/header/footer, /contacto select contains all new interes options (Plataforma de pagos, Tarjetas empresariales, Nómina y dispersión, Pagos internacionales). No pageerror or console error events captured.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer 'Servicios' column currently has 12 links (7 servicios + Personas/Aliados/Sucursales/Blog/Contacto). Task spec says 'columna Servicios con 7 links'. Actual behavior: 7 service links are present (Plataforma de pagos, TPV, Tarjetas empresariales, Nómina y dispersión, Pagos internacionales, Consultoría empresarial, Caja & comanda) plus 5 extra site links appended. This still satisfies '7 service links' but strictly exceeds the count if interpreted as 'exactly 7 li'. Consider moving Personas/Aliados/Sucursales/Blog/Contacto into a separate 'Compañía' column for cleaner IA.
seed_data_creation: TEST_* rows inserted via /api/contacto during pytest (as in previous iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4: extended backend parametrize to cover 6 new interes values (all pass). Full playwright validation of new service pages, redirect, header/footer, and contact select. If future changes affect Footer columns, note the current implementation includes 12 li in the 'Servicios' column (7 servicios + site links).
